# Privacy Policy — Branching Boxes

**Last Updated: \[7/15/2026]**

This Privacy Policy explains what information Branching Boxes ("the Game," "we," "us," or "our") collects, how it's used, and your choices, across all platforms the Game is available on (including Meta Quest and PC platforms).

## 1\. Information We Collect

We keep data collection minimal. The Game collects only what's needed to run accounts, save progress, and enable multiplayer:

**Account \& Player Data (via PlayFab)**

* A unique player ID (generated by PlayFab or linked to your platform login, e.g., Meta or Discord account ID).
* Display name / username.
* Game save data: progress, unlocked items, and inventory.
* Virtual currency balances and transaction history within the Game.

**Multiplayer/Networking Data (via Photon PUN2)**

* Real-time gameplay data needed to sync multiplayer sessions (e.g., player position, actions, session/room identifiers).
* Your IP address may be processed by Photon's relay servers as a normal part of establishing network connections — this is standard for any real-time multiplayer game and is not stored by us directly.

**Platform-Provided Data**

* If you log in via a platform (Meta Quest, Discord, Steam, etc.), that platform may share basic profile information (such as your platform username or account ID) with the Game to enable login and social features. This is governed by that platform's own privacy policy.

We do **not** currently use third-party analytics SDKs, advertising networks, or ad tracking. If this changes in the future, this Policy will be updated before such collection begins.

## 2\. How We Use Information

We use the information above to:

* Create and maintain your player account and save data;
* Enable real-time multiplayer gameplay;
* Track and manage virtual currency and inventory;
* Maintain game security (e.g., detecting cheating or abuse);
* Provide customer support if you contact us about an issue.

We do not sell your personal information, and we do not use your data for targeted advertising.

## 3\. How Information Is Shared

We share information only as necessary to operate the Game:

* **PlayFab (Microsoft):** stores account, inventory, and virtual currency data as our backend service provider. See [PlayFab's Privacy Policy](https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement) for details on how Microsoft processes this data on our behalf.
* **Photon Engine (Exit Games):** processes real-time networking data to enable multiplayer sessions. See [Photon's Privacy Policy](https://www.photonengine.com/en-US/Privacy) for details.
* **Platform providers** (Meta, Discord, Steam, etc.): provide authentication and platform-level services subject to their own privacy policies.
* **Legal requirements:** we may disclose information if required by law, court order, or to protect the safety, rights, or property of players or the public.

We do not share your information with third parties for their own marketing purposes.

## 4\. Data Retention

We retain account and save data for as long as your account remains active. If you request account deletion (see Section 6), we will delete or anonymize your data within a reasonable timeframe, except where retention is required for legal, security, or fraud-prevention purposes.

## 5\. Children's Privacy

The Game is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child under 13 has provided us with personal information, please contact us so we can delete it. Players' use of the Game is also subject to the age requirements of the platform they access it through (e.g., Meta Quest, Discord).

## 6\. Your Choices and Rights

Depending on your location, you may have rights to:

* Access the personal information we hold about you;
* Request correction of inaccurate data;
* Request deletion of your account and associated data;
* Object to or restrict certain processing.

To exercise any of these rights, contact us at \[YOUR CONTACT EMAIL]. Note that some data (e.g., held by PlayFab or platform providers) may also need to be addressed directly with those services depending on the request.

If you are in the European Economic Area (EEA), UK, or similar jurisdiction with data protection laws (e.g., GDPR), you may also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

## 7\. Data Security

We rely on PlayFab's and Photon's infrastructure, both of which implement industry-standard security measures, to store and transmit player data. No system is perfectly secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security, but we take reasonable steps to protect player information.

## 8\. International Data Transfers

Because PlayFab and Photon operate global infrastructure, your data may be processed in countries other than your own. These providers maintain their own compliance mechanisms for cross-border data transfers (e.g., Standard Contractual Clauses where applicable).

## 9\. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be reflected by updating the "Last Updated" date above, and where appropriate, an in-game notice.

## 10\. Contact Us

Questions about this Privacy Policy or your data can be directed to: \[4kvgteam@gmail.com]
